blocks.title: Queue
blocks.text: Queue cheezein aise rakhti hai ke pehle judi cheez pehle nikle, yaani First-In, First-Out (FIFO) usool. Cheezein peeche jurti aur aage se nikalti hain, jaise bank ya ticket counter ki qataar.

blocks.alt: Qataar mein khare logon ke siyah khaake (silhouettes), peeche ki taraf chhote hote hue. 'remove' wala teer dikhata hai ke aage wala shakhs nikal raha hai, aur ek mura hua teer dikhata hai ke naya shakhs peeche aa kar shamil ho raha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.3: Bank ke saamne logon ki qataar (kitab ki Figure 4.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Queue mein pehle kis ki khidmat hoti hai, aur naya aane wala kahan lagta hai?
blocks.explanation: Aage wala shakhs, jo pehle aaya; naya aane wala peeche lagta hai.

items: Queue: peeche jorein, aage se nikalein; First-In, First-Out.
